# Frank Perez Tattoo

> Francisco Perez is an award-winning tattoo artist in Jacksonville, North Carolina, specializing in custom Black & Grey realism. Sessions by appointment only; quotes are requested through the website form and continued on Instagram Direct.

## About

- Artist: Francisco Perez
- Specialty: custom Black & Grey realism (photographic details, textures, smooth transitions, strong contrast)
- Experience: 11 years, more than 20 awards from tattoo conventions
- Studio: Ink Corps, 391 Carolina Forest Blvd #500, Jacksonville, NC 28546, USA ([Google Maps](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pGPXMdZuAh7dSKX76))
- Bookings: by appointment only
- Languages on the website: English, Spanish, Portuguese

## How to request a tattoo quote

1. Open the quote form on the website (section #orcamento).
2. Answer four short questions: project type (full sleeve, leg sleeve, back / chest piece, medium / large custom realism), whether you are a returning client, your tattoo idea, and contact details (first name, last name, phone; email optional).
3. Send the summary to Francisco on Instagram Direct: https://ig.me/m/xl_ink

Prices depend on size, placement and detail, so they are given individually after the idea is reviewed.
